trace.question: Which was Lewis Hamilton first race? What was his points recorded for his first race event?
trace.evidence: first race refers to min(Year); Lewis Hamiltonrefers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname;

attempts.sql:
SELECT r.name, re.points
FROM results re
JOIN races r ON re.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON re.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY r.year ASC, r.round ASC
LIMIT 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT r.name, re.points
FROM results re
JOIN races r ON re.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON re.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY r.year ASC, r.round ASC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: Lewis Hamilton's first race in the dataset was the Malaysian Grand Prix, where he scored 8.0 points.
